AcCorps 0.4.1 · Orbivia

Purpose
AcCorps is an experimental application for listening to and recording audio. It has not been clinically validated and must not be used to make a diagnosis or replace medical assessment.

Listening
Use compatible wired or USB headphones with an external microphone. Start with low headphone volume and increase gain gradually. Digital output limiting does not guarantee a safe sound level with every headset. Filters change what you hear; they do not restore frequencies that the microphone did not capture.

Operation
Listening and recording stop when the application leaves the foreground, headphones are disconnected or audio priority is lost. The 50 Hz rejector is optional and can also remove useful signal.

Recordings and privacy
Recordings remain in the application’s private storage. No account, advertising, analytics or audio upload is included. Uninstalling the app removes its local recordings. Record only with permission from the people concerned.

Exports
WAV exports are unencrypted. Choose their destination carefully; an external provider may apply its own privacy policy. Exported copies remain outside the app.

Contact
Orbivia · pierre.charlier@orbivia.fr

Connect headphones with a microphone, then tap Listen. Choose a preset or adjust high-pass, low-pass, 50 Hz rejection and gain. Tap Record to keep the original sound. Name the session when finished, then play or export it from Recordings.
